draft.subject: One next step for Harbor Collective
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

You've got your first project set up in Wrenfield — nice start. The next step that usually makes the difference is getting your team in alongside you, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them.

A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if you're adding several.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's easiest for your team.

Best,
Chidi
